# Editorial Silence

## Overview

A near-white page set almost entirely in type: a light reading serif over a quiet sans, ink rules, square corners and no colour beyond ink and grey. A reading page carried by type alone: a light serif for the work, a quiet sans for the shop, ruled sections and no colour beyond ink and grey.

Generated by web-stylebook-mcp from the editorial-silence style. Values are the starting tokens compose_design_tokens returns without a visual contract. This file describes the light theme.

Visual profile: light reading serif, near-white page with ink rules, long-form reading spacing.

## Colors

Token names follow DESIGN.md conventions; the name in parentheses is the compose_design_tokens role.

- **primary** (text) `#1c1c1e`: Body text and headings.
- **on-primary** (textInverse) `#ffffff`: Text on a primary (ink) fill.
- **secondary** (textMuted) `#656566`: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text.
- **surface** (canvas) `#ffffff`: Page background.
- **surface-container** (surface) `#f8f8f8`: Panels and cards.
- **surface-container-high** (surfaceRaised) `#f4f4f4`: Raised surfaces such as inputs, menus, and popovers.
- **surface-variant** (surfaceMuted) `#ededed`: Muted fills such as hover rows, wells, and disabled areas.
- **outline** (borderStrong) `#a4a4a5`: Control boundaries that must stay visible.
- **outline-variant** (border) `#cdcdce`: Dividers and decorative rules.
- **accent** (accent) `#1c1c1e`: The style's identity accent.
- **on-accent** (accentText) `#ffffff`: Text on the accent.
- **focus** (focus) `#1c1c1e`: Focus indicator.

Status colors (positive, caution, critical, info) are not in this file; take them from compose_design_tokens.

Intended type: A light reading serif for the work, a quiet sans for the shop. These levels are starting points; confirm the faces against the intended type before use.

## Layout

Spacing tokens: 1 4px, 2 8px, 3 12px, 4 16px, 6 24px, 8 32px, gutter 24px, row 40px.

### Page structure

- **Opening:** A book's title page on a 12-column grid under a 2px ink rule: the title runs across 8 columns in Spectral 200 at clamp(4.5rem, 12.4vw, 11rem) with line-height 0.86, an italic Spectral line names what kind of work it is, and the author's name settles at the bottom of the same 8 columns. Columns 10-12 hold the purchase block under a 1px ink rule (edition, price in lining figures, release date, one solid ink rectangle button and a text link to the other edition), and a 1px grey imprint line closes the page with place and year. The product shows itself as its own text: the next block quotes its opening lines at columns 5-9.
- **Grid:** A 12-column grid with a 24px column gap, used asymmetrically: section headings span columns 1-6 with a muted intro at columns 8-12 (max 30em), biography text spans 7 columns beside a 4-column fact list, and quotations take 8 columns with their attribution in the last 3. Sections sit 136px apart (104px under 899px), each opened by a 1px ink rule with 26px above the heading, and the grids step down at 1079px, 899px and 599px.
- **Density:** Low: the body is Instrument Sans 1.0625rem at line-height 1.6, rows are separated by 1px grey rules with 22-30px of padding above and below, buttons are 48px tall, and one screen holds a heading, an intro and a few paragraphs or three or four ruled rows.
- **Type scale:** Spectral sets everything that belongs to the book and Instrument Sans everything that belongs to the shop. The title runs clamp(4.5rem, 12.4vw, 11rem) at weight 200 and -0.045em, section h2s clamp(2.25rem, 3.8vw, 3.25rem) at weight 200, line-height 1.05 and -0.035em with balanced wrapping, chapter openings in 2.75rem italic, and reading text in Spectral 300 at 1.1875rem/1.72 with old-style figures. Shop text, notes and buttons stay at 1rem-1.0625rem in Instrument Sans (500 only on buttons), and prices and dates switch to lining figures.
- **Section order:**
  1. Title page: 64px press bar with three anchor links and a basket count, then title, kind, author and the column 10-12 purchase block
  2. Opening lines: the first sentences of the work quoted at columns 5-9, with a caption and a link to the extract
  3. Extract: a ruled heading and intro, then two facing pages of real text with running head and folios
  4. About the author: biography over 7 columns beside a ruled definition list of facts
  5. Editions: ruled selection rows with pages, ISBN, publication date and price, then an order row with the ink button
  6. Reviews and readings: a lead quotation at a larger size, further quotations in ruled rows, then dated events with a reservation form
- **Signature moves:**
  - Title page with a ruled purchase column: Opens like the book itself, so the title and author carry the page while the price and order button sit in plain view without a banner or hero image.
  - Facing-pages spread of the real text: Shows the work as it will be read, which is the strongest proof a publisher, author or long-read page can offer.
  - Edition ledger rows with an ink selection box: Lists formats, plans or variants as a printed price list the reader can compare and choose from, in place of pricing cards.

### Must-haves on the article page

The style restyles these but never removes them; every first-screen item goes in the opening.

- **Author**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Name the author near the headline, with rel=author, itemprop=author, or a "By …" line.
- **Publication date**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Show the publication or update date near the headline, ideally in a time element.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: Stay in neutrals; carry emphasis with weight, size, and space. (style rule accent-hues)
- Do: Keep the corner radius of cards, panels, buttons, inputs, and images at 0px or less. (style rule corner-radius)
- Do: Remove soft elevation; separate surfaces with rules, borders, or flat fills, as this style does. (style rule shadow-blur)
- Do: Replace the sans/monospace display face with the style's authored family. (style rule typeface)
- Don't: Centered hero over a gradient blob (pattern gradient-blob-hero)
- Don't: All-text centered stack (pattern centered-stack-hero)
- Don't: Stock-photo hero (pattern stock-photo-hero)
- Don't: Logo strip (pattern logo-strip)
- Don't: Generic “trusted by” band (pattern trusted-by-band)
- Don't: Icon feature cards (pattern icon-feature-grid)
- Don't: Testimonial carousel (pattern testimonial-carousel)
- Don't: Generic closing CTA banner (pattern closing-cta-banner)
- Don't: Generic SaaS page skeleton (pattern generic-saas-skeleton)
